outcome: Number of follow-up visits per pregnancy
Proportion of patients attending routine antenatal follow-up
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic (March-June 2020), there was no significant increase in obstetric/neonatal morbidity and mortality compared to the same period in previous years, except for a significant increase in the rate of spontaneous abortions.
mod_finding: The proportion of Cesarean sections was higher during the COVID-19 period, but this difference was not statistically significant.
